title: SCT Interface
text: scimagR provides R wrappers Spinal Cord Toolbox (SCT) command-line tools. code vignette run vignette built, needs SCT images. wrappers handle: Path resolution (respects SCT_DIR environment variable) command syntax installed SCT version: SCT 7.0 replaced sct_deepseg -task <task> sct_deepseg <task> renamed tasks; wrappers read version sct_version use matching form Input validation Idempotent execution (skip output exists) Structured error reporting: failed command gives warning end error output, wrapper returns NA; command exits normally without writing expected file Optional QC report generation

title: SCT Interface
text: contrast-agnostic model (sct_deepseg spinalcord):
code: library(scimagR)  sc_seg <- sct_segment_sc(   input = "sub-01_T2w.nii.gz",   qc_dir = "qc/" ) # "sub-01_T2w_seg.nii.gz"

title: SCT Interface
text: SCIsegV2 (sct_deepseg lesion_sci_t2) segments lesion spinal cord. lesion mask returned; cord mask saved next *_sc_seg.nii.gz:
code: lesion_seg <- sct_segment_lesion(   input = "sub-01_T2w.nii.gz",   qc_dir = "qc/" ) # "sub-01_T2w_lesion_seg.nii.gz" (and "sub-01_T2w_sc_seg.nii.gz")

title: SCT Interface
text: sct_label_vertebrae names outputs segmentation. wrapper returns labelled segmentation (*_seg_labeled.nii.gz), file sct_process_segmentation() needs; disc labels written next (*_seg_labeled_discs.nii.gz).
code: vert_labels <- sct_label_vertebrae(   input = "sub-01_T2w.nii.gz",   segmentation = sc_seg ) # "sub-01_T2w_seg_labeled.nii.gz"

title: SCT Interface
text: Without vert, sct_process_segmentation() averages metrics slices segmentation, VertLevel column CSV empty.
code: # Lesion parameters (volume, length, tissue bridges): an Excel spreadsheet, # *_analysis.xlsx (*_analysis.xls with SCT 6.4) lesion_xlsx <- sct_analyze_lesion(   lesion_seg = lesion_seg,   sc_seg = "sub-01_T2w_sc_seg.nii.gz" )  # Morphometric parameters (CSA, diameters), averaged over C2-C7 and # reported per vertebral level csa_csv <- sct_process_segmentation(   sc_seg = sc_seg,   vert_labels = vert_labels,   vert = 2:7,   perlevel = TRUE )

title: SCT Interface
text: segmentation wrappers write QC reports given qc_dir. make report afterwards, use sct_generate_qc():
code: # Spinal cord segmentation sct_generate_qc(   input = "sub-01_T2w.nii.gz",   segmentation = sc_seg,   qc_dir = "qc/" )  # Lesion: the cord mask as `segmentation`, the lesion mask as `lesion` sct_generate_qc(   input = "sub-01_T2w.nii.gz",   segmentation = "sub-01_T2w_sc_seg.nii.gz",   lesion = lesion_seg,   qc_dir = "qc/",   process = "sct_deepseg_lesion",   plane = "sagittal" )

title: SCT Interface
text: SCT wrappers write images idempotent default. output file already exists, function returns existing path without re-running:
code: # First call: runs segmentation sct_segment_sc("sub-01_T2w.nii.gz")  # Second call: skips, returns existing path sct_segment_sc("sub-01_T2w.nii.gz")  # Force re-run: sct_segment_sc("sub-01_T2w.nii.gz", overwrite = TRUE)
